name: Vergence SphereCast
summary: A thin capsule is swept along the gaze direction across the range of depth error around the vergence point, and the object closest to the vergence point is selected.
howItWorks: The sweep length is twice the measured depth error at that distance, so the target is caught even when vergence depth is wrong. It performed about as well as a plain gaze ray, with slightly fewer tries. The study (Varjo Aero) had users select atoms in a cluttered molecule model, confirming with a wink, which beat dwell and double blink in an earlier test.
limitations: Can pick a wrong object in clutter.

relationships.note: Compared with a gaze ray through the vergence point.
Both account for vergence depth error.
